# A fresh invocation resumes a projection by name and commits the resolution.

# Keep the base commit for Git's three-way apply. Both upstream and
# feature.patch replace the same line from that commit.
env GIT_DEFAULT_HASH=sha1
git -C give/repo init -q -b main
git -C give/repo add file.txt
git -C give/repo commit -qm base
cp give/upstream.txt give/repo/file.txt
git -C give/repo commit -qam upstream

# Install the layer and point its clone operation at this run's source repo.
mkdir definition/layers
mv give/layer definition/layers/0001-feature
cd definition
git init -q -b main
exec sed 's|@WORK@|'$WORK'|g' layers/0001-feature/layer.toml
cp stdout layers/0001-feature/layer.toml

# Creation stops at the conflict and reports how to resume the projection.
! exec layerctl projection create demo --worktree $WORK/workspace
stderr 'resolve it then run layerctl projection continue demo$'

# Resolve the file in the stopped workspace and check the commit from continue.
cp $WORK/give/resolved.txt $WORK/workspace/file.txt
exec layerctl projection continue demo
git -C $WORK/workspace show HEAD:file.txt
cmp stdout $WORK/give/resolved.txt

-- give/repo/file.txt --
base
-- give/layer/layer.toml --
[vcs]
commit-msg = "Apply feature"

[[operation]]
[operation.git-clone]
url = "@WORK@/give/repo"

[[operation]]
[operation.patch]
file = "feature.patch"
-- give/layer/feature.patch --
diff --git a/file.txt b/file.txt
index df967b96a579e45a18b8251732d16804b2e56a55..a7453f07505c42ea8d6fdda75fa91710c81c53d6 100644
--- a/file.txt
+++ b/file.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-base
+feature
-- give/upstream.txt --
upstream
-- give/resolved.txt --
resolved
